Subject: Promo credit allocation for SI-sourced pilot (Cohort B)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier — excited to get Cohort B running. Attached is the ledger export our SI partner (BrightLane) requested: it lists 12 pilot accounts that qualify for the marketplace promo of 10k tokens each. Can you confirm Redwood can issue vouchers against these accounts and whether we need any extra paperwork from BrightLane?

- Can Redwood push 10k-token vouchers per account to the CloudBridge marketplace by May 7?
- Do you need a signed MSA addendum or can this be covered by the partner referral agreement we have on file (signed Feb 2026)?
- Any gating from compliance (SOC2 evidence) that would block issuance?

Attached: credit-alloc-COHORTB-0427.csv (CSV) — includes account email, company, and intended voucher id.

If it helps, looping marketplace ops: marketplace-ops@cloudbridge.io.

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo credit allocation for SI-sourced pilot (Cohort B)

Hi Maya — thanks for sending the ledger. I reviewed the CSV and the list looks clean (no duplicates, all customer emails are corporate domains). A few notes and next steps: 

- We can issue 10k-token marketplace vouchers per account.
- I need Finance to confirm allocation against our promotional budget and Finance Ops to create the voucher batch in the marketplace backend.
- For paperwork: the referral agreement from Feb 2026 should be sufficient, but Compliance will need a short attestation from BrightLane that they will not re-sell credits (standard wording). Can your SI provide that via email?

Connor — can you own voucher creation and confirm ETA? Kimberly — please confirm budget availability and whether we need a PO from CloudBridge.

Target: vouchers live by 2027-05-07 EOD PST. If any blockers surface we'll communicate ASAP.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415-555-0192
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo credit allocation for SI-sourced pilot (Cohort B)

Vanessa / Connor — reviewed the CSV and flagged a couple of items before we finalize budget: 

- Two accounts (row 7 and row 9) have disputed billing domains (they show both a cloudbridge.com alias and a personal Gmail). We need the corporate account confirmed for voucher binding.
- Our FY27 partner promo budget has ~USD 42k remaining for May allocations. 12 * 10k-token vouchers roughly map to $36k estimated spend (per previous token cost model) — clearing that looks good, but please confirm whether we expect any overage or top-ups.
- We require a short one-paragraph attestation from BrightLane per Vanessa's note. Kimberly (Finance) cannot finalize without that.

Also attaching recommended voucher TTL: 90 days after issuance. If CloudBridge wants longer, we need explicit approval (affects liability).

Quoted for context:
> From: Maya Patel <maya@cloudbridge.io>
> Attached: credit-alloc-COHORTB-0427.csv

I'll mark as "pending finance sign-off" in the internal tracker and will confirm by EOD 2027-05-03.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Partner Finance Lead | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Promo credit allocation for SI-sourced pilot (Cohort B) — approved and voucher handoff

Maya / Marketplace ops — thanks for the quick turnaround. Final update and actions: 

1) Approval: Finance approved the allocation (12 vouchers at 10k tokens each). Budget covered under FY27 partner promo (deal DB-9382).
2) Issues resolved: BrightLane confirmed corporate emails for the two flagged accounts earlier today — we have their attestation note on file.
3) Voucher ops: Connor will create the voucher batch and push to CloudBridge marketplace today. Expect voucher codes to land in the Drive folder linked below and for the marketplace to automatically bind to the listed corporate accounts.
4) TTL & terms: vouchers issued with 90-day TTL. If you need to extend, please file a request to partner-ops@redwood.ai with justification.

Attachments: voucher-terms-SI-cohort.docx (attestation template we used); credit-alloc-COHORTB-0427.csv (original).

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DB-9382
Drive (voucher codes, once created): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleLink

Connor — can you confirm when batch is pushed (reply-all) so CloudBridge can notify BrightLane?

Best,
